name: Lyo.FantasyFootball.Postgres.Tests
tagline: Testcontainers coverage for the fantasy football Postgres store.
description: Uses a PostgreSQL Testcontainers fixture and the real `PostgresFantasyFootballStore`. Covers league upsert, direct-message members, message order, and trade items.
features: League save with the same ESPN ids updates members and teams.
A direct message lists the other member.
Messages come back in time order, and a trade keeps both sides.
